title: JANZEN SUNSHINE SUPERMAN ORIGI...
reason: Jantzen Sunshine Superman c1970s advertising poster, a listed collectable catalogued under a misspelt maker name; a specialist dealer asks four figures for a repaired copy (see findings).
findings: Large flat-colour advertising poster printed 'jantzen SUNSHINE SUPERMAN'. The catalogue title spells the maker 'Janzen', so a search for Jantzen may miss it. Three muscled men in 1960s to 70s swimwear (striped knit top, floral trunks, red and white striped shorts) in front of a pink, yellow and orange sunburst on a red ground with a green border, heavy black outlines. No printer's imprint, date or signature is legible in the photo. The only small mark is a short black L-shaped stroke on the right hand figure's leg, which looks like part of the drawing. Photographed held by binder clips at top and bottom, not framed or backed. Web check (pages read 19/10/2026): the same dealer copy, item CL197-101, 'Jantzen Sunshine Superman', c1970s colour screenprint, 99.8 x 66.7 cm, 'Repaired minor tears and missing portions to edges. Linen-backed.', is shown at AUD $1,250 at https://www.joseflebovicgallery.com/pages/books/CL197-101/jantzen-sunshine-superman and at AUD $1,000, marked 'Sold out', at https://www.postersandprints.com.au/products/jantzen-sunshine-superman . These are dealer asking prices for one repaired copy, not realised auction prices. The Armitage poster's proportions match that size, but its size, age and originality cannot be proven from the photo.
condition: Colours bright and the green border looks complete on all sides. Top edge ripples and curls between the two binder clips. No tears, folds or stains visible at photo size, but the clip areas and the back are hidden. Size not stated in the title.
rescore_note: Large Jantzen 'Sunshine Superman' flat-colour advertising poster, c1970s; the same design (item CL197-101, 99.8 x 66.7 cm, repaired and linen-backed) is asked at AUD $1,250 at https://www.joseflebovicgallery.com/pages/books/CL197-101/jantzen-sunshine-superman and AUD $1,000, marked sold out, at https://www.postersandprints.com.au/products/jantzen-sunshine-superman (both read 19/10/2026; dealer asking prices, not auction results). This copy looks cleaner (bright, border complete, no tears seen) but age and originality are unproven, so discounted for the chance of a reprint.
